questions.text: In HTML, which attribute reference other elements that label the control?
questions.explanation: aria-labelledby references element IDs whose text labels the control.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute reference descriptive help text for a control?
questions.explanation: aria-describedby references help or description text for a control.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute toggle the expanded/collapsed state of a disclosure widget?
questions.explanation: aria-expanded reflects whether content is expanded (true/false).

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute declare that an element is hidden from assistive tech?
questions.explanation: aria-hidden='true' removes the element and its subtree from the accessibility tree.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute assign a landmark role to an element?
questions.explanation: role defines the ARIA role; e.g., 'navigation', 'main', 'banner'.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute prevent focusing and events on an element while keeping it in DOM?
questions.explanation: inert makes an element and subtree unfocusable and not exposed to assistive tech.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute embed an HTML string directly as iframe content?
questions.explanation: iframe srcdoc provides the content of the frame inline rather than via src URL.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute apply strong restrictions to iframe content?
questions.explanation: sandbox on iframes enforces restrictions (scripts, forms, origin, top-nav) unless explicitly allowed.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute supply a cryptographic hash for Subresource Integrity?
questions.explanation: integrity on <script>/<link> checks fetched resource against a cryptographic hash.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute associate a Content Security Policy nonce with inline script/style?
questions.explanation: nonce allows CSP to whitelist specific inline scripts/styles for execution.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute indicate the CORS mode for resource fetching?
questions.explanation: crossorigin can be 'anonymous' or 'use-credentials' for cross-origin fetches.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute control referrer information sent with requests?
questions.explanation: referrerpolicy governs how much referrer data is sent (e.g., no-referrer, origin).

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute lazy‑load images or iframes?
questions.explanation: loading='lazy' defers loading until near viewport; eager loads immediately.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute hint the browser how to decode an image?
questions.explanation: decoding may be 'sync', 'async', or 'auto' to influence decoding strategy.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute influence the priority of fetching an image or iframe?
questions.explanation: fetchpriority can be 'high', 'low', or 'auto' to hint resource priority.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute declare a script as an ECMAScript module?
questions.explanation: type='module' enables ESM features and uses defer-like loading semantics by default.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute avoid running a script in browsers that support modules?
questions.explanation: nomodule makes a classic script skip execution in module-capable browsers.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute prevent search engines from following a link for ranking?
questions.explanation: nofollow tells crawlers not to treat the link as a ranking signal.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute mark a link as user‑generated content?
questions.explanation: rel='ugc' indicates the link came from user-generated content.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute mark a link as paid or sponsored?
questions.explanation: rel='sponsored' denotes advertising, sponsorships or compensation.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute preload an ECMAScript module dependency?
questions.explanation: modulepreload hints the browser to fetch ESM dependencies early.

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute declare the resource type for a preloaded asset?
questions.explanation: The 'as' attribute is required on preload to set the correct resource type (e.g., script, style, font).

questions.text: In HTML, which attribute turn an element into a region whose content is editable?
questions.explanation: contenteditable enables in-place editing of element content.

questions.text: Which value of the rel on <link> attribute will preload a critical resource early?
questions.explanation: rel='preload' fetches a resource early; pair with 'as' and crossorigin for fonts.

questions.text: Which value of the rel on <link> attribute will preconnect to an origin to reduce latency?
questions.explanation: preconnect opens early connections (DNS, TCP, TLS) to an origin.

questions.text: Which value of the rel on <link> attribute will resolve DNS early for a domain?
questions.explanation: dns-prefetch asks the browser to resolve DNS ahead of time.

questions.text: Which value of the rel on <link> attribute will fetch a resource for likely future navigation?
questions.explanation: prefetch fetches resources at low priority for possible later use.

questions.text: Which value of the rel on <link> attribute will load a page in the background ahead of navigation?
questions.explanation: prerender renders a full page in the background in some browsers.

questions.text: Which value of the as on <link rel="preload"> attribute will preload a font?
questions.explanation: Use as='font' and include crossorigin for fonts to avoid double fetch.

questions.text: Which value of the as on <link rel="preload"> attribute will preload a stylesheet?
questions.explanation: as='style' indicates the resource is a stylesheet.

questions.text: Which value of the as on <link rel="preload"> attribute will preload a script?
questions.explanation: as='script' indicates a classic script; combine with modulepreload for ESM graphs.

questions.text: Which value of the crossorigin attribute will fetch without credentials for CORS?
questions.explanation: anonymous omits credentials but allows CORS if permitted by server.

questions.text: Which value of the crossorigin attribute will include credentials (cookies, auth) in CORS request?
questions.explanation: use-credentials includes credentials; server must send appropriate CORS headers.

questions.text: Which value of the referrerpolicy attribute will send no referrer information?
questions.explanation: no-referrer suppresses the Referer header on all requests.

questions.text: Which value of the referrerpolicy attribute will send only scheme/host/port as referrer?
questions.explanation: origin restricts referrer to just the origin.

questions.text: Which value of the loading on attribute will eagerly load the resource as soon as possible?
questions.explanation: loading='eager' bypasses lazy loading and loads immediately.

questions.text: Which value of the loading on attribute will defer loading until near the viewport?
questions.explanation: loading='lazy' defers fetching until close to the viewport.

questions.text: Which value of the decoding on attribute will decode image off the main thread if possible?
questions.explanation: decoding='async' asks the UA to decode asynchronously.

questions.text: Which value of the decoding on attribute will decode image immediately?
questions.explanation: decoding='sync' prioritizes immediate decoding, possibly blocking rendering.

questions.text: Which value of the fetchpriority attribute will signal very important resource?
questions.explanation: fetchpriority='high' hints the browser to prioritize fetching.

questions.text: Which value of the fetchpriority attribute will de‑prioritize a resource?
questions.explanation: fetchpriority='low' hints low importance.

questions.text: Which value of the aria-live attribute will announce changes assertively?
questions.explanation: assertive live regions are announced immediately, interrupting the user.

questions.text: Which value of the aria-live attribute will announce changes politely?
questions.explanation: polite announcements wait for the user to be idle.

questions.text: Which value of the th scope attribute will indicate header applies to a column?
questions.explanation: scope='col' binds the header to its column.

questions.text: Which value of the th scope attribute will indicate header applies to a row?
questions.explanation: scope='row' binds the header to its row.

questions.text: Which value of the inputmode attribute will hint numeric keypad with digits only?
questions.explanation: inputmode='numeric' suggests digits-only keypad.

questions.text: Which value of the inputmode attribute will hint a keyboard for decimal numbers?
questions.explanation: inputmode='decimal' suggests a keypad with a decimal separator.

options: It can appear before <tbody> in markup and still render at the bottom
It must be omitted when using <thead>

questions.text: Where should <summary> appear inside <details> for correct behavior?
questions.explanation: The first summary inside details is the toggle; spec recommends it as the first child.

questions.text: Which statement about custom element names is correct?
questions.explanation: Custom element names require a hyphen (e.g., photo-gallery) to avoid collisions with future HTML tags.

questions.text: Which statement about <script type="module"> is TRUE?
options: Module scripts are deferred by default
async forces modules to execute in order
nomodule makes module scripts run in legacy browsers
questions.explanation: ES modules use deferred execution and have their own dependency graph.

questions.text: When preloading a cross‑origin font, what must you include to avoid a double fetch or failure?
options: crossorigin attribute and correct CORS headers
questions.explanation: Fonts require CORS; include crossorigin and ensure server sends appropriate headers.

questions.text: Which is TRUE about the 'hidden' attribute compared to aria-hidden="true"?
options: 'hidden' removes the element from layout and accessibility; aria-hidden keeps layout
Both do the exact same thing
aria-hidden also prevents CSS from applying
hidden exposes the element to screen readers but not sighted users
questions.explanation: hidden behaves like display:none; aria-hidden hides from AT but element remains in layout.

questions.text: Which is TRUE about <figure> and <figcaption>?
options: <figcaption> should be the first or last child of <figure>
questions.explanation: The recommended placement is first or last child to associate the caption clearly.

questions.text: Which is TRUE about the 'dataset' API for data-* attributes?
questions.explanation: Hyphenated names map to camelCase properties of the dataset object.

questions.text: Which statement about <script defer> is TRUE?
options: It executes before HTML parsing begins
It guarantees execution order for async scripts
It works only for external scripts
It blocks HTML parsing until execution
questions.explanation: defer applies to external scripts, downloading in parallel and executing after parsing in order.

questions.text: Which is TRUE about 'tabindex' usage?
options: tabindex is for CSS stacking order
Use large positive values to control order precisely
questions.explanation: Positive tabindex harms keyboard navigation; use 0 to follow DOM order, -1 for programmatic focus only.

questions.text: Which statement about <ol> is TRUE?

questions.text: Which input type does NOT honor the 'pattern' attribute for validation?

questions.text: Which is TRUE about a disabled <fieldset>?

questions.explanation: A disabled fieldset disables all descendant controls apart from those within its first legend.

questions.text: Which attribute on <track> specifies the kind of text track (e.g., captions)?
